title: Carlos Ghosn dismissed as Nissan Chairman after arrest
trigger: Carlos Ghosn was arrested in Japan on suspicion of financial misconduct including underreporting his compensation, leading Nissan's board to dismiss him as Chairman and Representative Director.

timeline.event: Ghosn arrested in Tokyo on suspicion of underreporting his income by about $44 million over eight years
Nissan board votes to remove Ghosn as Chairman and Representative Director
Ghosn released on bail after more than a month in detention
Ghosn flees Japan to Lebanon while awaiting trial

outcome.summary: Ghosn was arrested in November 2018 and dismissed from Nissan's board. He was released on bail in December 2018 but fled Japan to Lebanon at the end of 2019 while awaiting trial. Nissan pursued civil claims against him for damages. The French prosecutor dropped its investigation in 2023.

claims.text: Ghosn was arrested in Tokyo on November 19, 2018 on suspicion of underreporting his compensation
Nissan's board voted to remove Ghosn as Chairman and Representative Director on November 22, 2018
Hiroto Saikawa became Nissan's CEO after Ghosn's removal
Ghosn was released on bail on December 25, 2018 after over a month in detention
Ghosn fled Japan to Lebanon on December 29, 2019 while awaiting trial
